verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Flagsmith. The nearest items don't count. The Bayesian statistics engine is statistical experiment analysis, not AI. The 'intelligent release assistant' wording describes rule-based pipeline automation. The MCP server lets external AI assistants call the Admin API, which is a developer building block, not an in-product insight feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
